You slide through the door when the room turns gold, White jacket, slow grin, hands steady and bold. One cube in the glass, orange peel in your hand, You stir that Old Fashioned like you own the whole damn bar. You say, “Bonsoir, sweetheart, tell me what you need,” Your voice rolls low while the glasses all gleam. Bitters, bourbon, a twist, then you lean in close— I came for one drink, but you know how this goes. Old Fashioned, made by your hands, One slow turn and I forget my plans. “À votre santé,” you murmur so low, You pour that amber and you steal the show. Old Fashioned, keep the night on hold, A little bit of sugar, a little too bold. “Encore un verre?” You smile, I say yes— That bartender’s got dangerous finesse. You polish the bar while the last song fades, Tell me, “Mon cœur, the best things take their time.” A measured pour, that bittersweet trace, You set down the glass and remember my name. Pas trop vite, take it slow, Orange peel turns in the amber glow. You raise one brow; I laugh, “D’accord,” Then you make that drink like you’ve done it before. 【影片】 https://youtu.be/q4yQ40jI5rk 世界忙著錯亂/我也是/我迷失在/各種愛你 【創作】 這首歌打磨得比平常更久（了很多）。那幾天心思真的完全不在眼前，既然怎麼都拉不回來，乾脆順著它，把那些亂七八糟的東西整理成歌。 這種歌當然不是站遠遠唱，是貼著你的耳朵唱的。原本有想過放 Sax，但後來覺得太自嗨，它很容易自己帥起來，這首不需要。所以換成 Cello，不是拿來煽情，是慢慢把你拉進來。後面偶爾會有一個比較亮的男聲，把前一句輕輕接回來，像有些念頭明明已經過去了，卻還是不肯真的走。 原本以為這首唱完，總是可以稍微專心一點。 結果沒有： 現在我更急著去見你了。 【音樂】 Musically, the track is built around a slow Trip Hop groove with deep bass, Rhodes, and a close-miked low male vocal. Occasional brighter male backing vocals softly echo fragments of the previous line. Cello replaces sax throughout, keeping the arrangement restrained and intimate rather than showy.

一句成語，四個字， 卻可能藏著流傳千年的故事。 《成語狂想曲》嘗試把我們熟悉的中文成語，放進現代 EDM 電子舞曲的節奏裡，讓古老的文字不只存在於課本與書頁，而是跟著鼓點、Bass 與旋律重新跳動。 從古人的智慧，到今天的節拍； 從四字成語，到電子舞台。 這不是一堂成語課， 而是一場屬於中文字的音樂狂想。 當千年的語言遇上現代電子音樂， 成語，也可以很潮。 Chinese Idioms × Modern Beats Past Wisdom × Future Sounds 原創詞曲概念：小范 AI 音樂協作製作：Suno
